title: Poholos
profTagline: Off-grid Bluetooth chat: messages hop phone to phone, no internet and no server. Compatible with bitchat.
installDesc: Works offline, opens as an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
logsVerdictOkSub: The node is on the network. {id}
logsVerdictPermSub: Android refused: {p}. Without it the node starts and stays silent.
logsVerdictLocationSub: With location off a BLE scan returns empty and reports no error at all.
logsVerdictBtOffSub: Turn Bluetooth on — without it the node neither hears nor calls out.
logsVerdictBtNoneSub: The device does not report Bluetooth Low Energy support.
logsVerdictNeedsAppSub: The mesh lives in the native shell. A browser has no transport.
logsVerdictStaleSub: The installed APK predates the mesh. Update it from the profile.
logsVerdictWrongApkSub: The installed app does not carry the mesh capability. It needs the mesh-flavour APK — Download APK in the profile, installed over this one.
fieldSearching: Listening to the air. Whoever opens Poholos nearby appears here.
roomEmptyAlone: Quiet. The moment someone comes within range, the word starts here.
queuedBanner: No one nearby. It will go out as soon as someone appears.
faultBanner: The radio is silent. The Logs tab says why.
dmEmpty: No one to whisper with yet. Wait until someone comes within range.
nickHint: Seen by others nearby. Your identity is a key held on this device.
bgNote: Poholos runs in the background as a quiet notification — that is how Android keeps the network alive.
